name: scripted_shell_debug_workflow
description: Deterministic multi-turn session mimicking a real debugging loop: write a script with a bug and run it (turn 1, real shell run surfaces the failure), then fix it and re-run (turn 2). Exercises the write -> run -> rewrite -> run cycle over the real sandbox. Runs in CI.
input: Write calc.py that prints the product of 6 and 7, then run it.

scripted_responses.text: calc.py has a syntax error near the multiplication, so it failed to run.
Fixed the syntax error; calc.py now runs and prints 42.

user_turns: That failed — fix the syntax error and run it again.
